scientific_integrity: Analytical proof controls compact times and the unbounded beat-phase scale. Supplementary finite diagnostics do not certify all-time positivity. Earlier integer-resonance and polynomial-shift results are credited. Unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk.
scientific_limitations: First-order two-sided detuning only. The constant is an exact variational maximum, not a claimed elementary closed form. No complete global arbitrary-frequency classification, no case b<a, no independent validation.
scientific_scope: Near every integer frequency ratio m>=2, for the quintic moment polynomial with one real pole and two complex-conjugate pairs; normalized real-pole gap delta=(b-a)/c>=0.
title: Linear detuning law at integer resonances of quintic Hausdorff moments
